items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: And there was Bonnie Begard and Adolph Alexander. They was playing with a band by the name of Homer Begard.

ctx.x: Because Papa, Teo was a teacher quite a bit. Yeah, he had a lot of scholars. He taught some of those, Albert Nicholas too.
Yeah, I think he taught Bonnie Begard.
Yeah, I think Albert Nicholas, no, three or four. Even Big Eye Louie, I believe, took some lessons from Papa, Teo. Yeah. I think Big Eye taught him.
